Pick better value `binwidth`.   # Scale tallest bin to 1 ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(displ)) +   ggplot2::geom_histogram(ggplot2::aes(y = after_stat(count / max(count)))) #> `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.   # Use a transparent version of colour for fill ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(class, hwy)) +   ggplot2::geom_boxplot(ggplot2::aes(colour = class, fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, 0.4))))   # Use stage to modify the scaled fill ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(class, hwy)) +   ggplot2::geom_boxplot(ggplot2::aes(fill = stage(class, after_scale = alpha(fill, 0.4))))   # Making a proportional stacked density plot ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(cty)) +   ggplot2::geom_density(     ggplot2::aes(       colour = factor(cyl),       fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, 0.3)),       y = after_stat(count / sum(n[!duplicated(group)]))     ),     position = "stack", bw = 1   ) +   ggplot2::geom_density(bw = 1)   # Imitating a ridgeline plot ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(cty, colour = factor(cyl))) +   ggplot2::geom_ribbon(     stat = "density", outline.type = "upper",     ggplot2::aes(       fill = after_scale(alpha(colour, 0.3)),       ymin = after_stat(group),       ymax = after_stat(group + ndensity)     )   )   # Labelling a bar plot ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(class)) +   ggplot2::geom_bar() +   ggplot2::geom_text(     ggplot2::aes(       y = after_stat(count + 2),       label = after_stat(count)     ),     stat = "count"   )   # Labelling the upper hinge of a boxplot, # inspired by June Choe ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::mpg, ggplot2::aes(displ, class)) +   ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +   ggplot2::geom_text(     ggplot2::aes(       label = after_stat(xmax),       x = stage(displ, after_stat = xmax)     ),     stat = "boxplot", hjust = -0.5   )

Isoform suffixes stripped lookup exact match found. strip_prefix Regular expression matching prefixes strip query IDs. Defaults "^(transcript:|cds:|gene:)". strip_suffix Regular expression matching suffixes strip query IDs. Defaults "(\\.t\\d+|-T\\d+)$" (transcript isoform numbers, covering .t1 Funannotate-style -T1 conventions). metadata Optional metadata list.

what: A dense landscape of HLA-A variation
title: 1. Projecting amino acid changes onto transcript models
text: example summarizes 5,998 named HLA-alleles, MHC class heavy chain, IPD-IMGT/HLA release 3.66.0. Comparison *02:01:01:01 produces 1,212 amino-acid substitutions 334 mature-protein residues. substitution head, coloured alternative amino acid’s chemical group.
